title: Hopeverse: Car Chase v3 (section plan: hard brake + konnakol surprise)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: breathless car chase film score cue, composed like a film composer, not a DJ mix
a deep close heartbeat 'lub-dub' on felt kick and low taiko as the rhythmic spine, the tune locked to it
the car's own sounds as instruments: engine rev tuned to the root as bass drone, gear-shift clunks as snare, tuned tyre-screech stabs, ticking indicator as hi-hat
glitch-chopped veena riff and pitched-down mridangam hits
sixteenth-note string ostinato, big brass, real drummer

positive_local_styles: only a slow nervous close heartbeat
engine idling on the root
ticking indicator
a gritty synth plays a rising 3-note call: root, minor third, fifth, held and bent up
the heartbeat speeds up bar by bar
engine revs up with it
drummer's pickup fill
one reversed veena swell into a huge hit
racing heartbeat pulse at full 160 BPM drive
bold 4-bar brass and synth theme phrased on the heartbeats
sixteenth-note strings and veena racing
tuned tyre-screech stabs answering each phrase
a long loud tyre screech of a car braking hard
the orchestra slides down in pitch with the brake and stops dead
engine stalls
only the pounding heartbeat
a deep male voice recites fast Carnatic konnakol rhythm syllables exactly on the heartbeat, getting faster
lines: ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu, ta ka dhi mi ta ka jhu nu

positive_local_styles: the full orchestra and drums slam back in together with a huge hit
up a whole step to F sharp minor
the heartbeat even harder, double-time percussion
the theme varied and climbing, strings counter-melody
short male shouts 'hey!'
everything at full power
the theme in its biggest highest version on brass and strings
taiko and heartbeat hitting together on every downbeat
one final hit
a beat of quiet, a car door slams shut, the engine switches off
the heartbeat slows to calm
the rising 3-note call rings out alone on a veena

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct: v2 really good but missing the surprise factor; add at least one hard braking. Prompt-only takes ignored the timed brake/konnakol, so this uses an ElevenLabs composition plan that holds each section's length.

story: A night car chase, from ignition to escape.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
